first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMBs and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. I would verify that evidence alongside the onboarding result because onboarding completion is also deteriorating and may offer a more sustainable lever. Pricing should remain a guarded, segment-specific test until margin, customer quality, and downstream retention are confirmed.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected because its acquisition lift came with a 12% retention decline and failure at the first renewal cycle. Uncertainty remains about whether the historical onboarding effect will replicate under current conditions, so this should be tested rather than broadly rolled out.
